## History

Unique minimum class. Reproduced on 2026-10-17 by complete pynauty enumeration and nauty geng, each checked against independent Burnside counts. No saturated graph through 13 edges; exactly one class at 14. The exact graph6 passes independent DFS and subset-Hamiltonicity checks. A hand-checkable cycle and nonedge-orbit certificate is included in v4. This corrects the value 15 in Remark 1 of Zhang-Luo-Shigeno (2015). HoG canonical search on 2026-10-18 found no match. The v4 archive and HoG record were published and checked live on 2026-10-18. Downloaded canonical graph6 is isomorphic to this witness and independently saturated.
